regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad rotation (8 of 16 eligible) with Oil & Gas Producers as the confident, crowded leader held together by strong breadth (0.786) and high durability (0.68), but with mixed trend-health and no one-narrative dominance (one_narrative=false). Gold Miners is the challenger on a 0.502 margin. The detector's rated edge here is drawdown control only (gate_helps=true); momentum rank-IC is weak and rotation timing is display-only, so any lean is my judgement, not an extracted forecast. Track record shows a 64.6% hit rate but only 34.3% directional accuracy over 99 calls — signal-direction has been poor, so I default to low conviction across the board.
emerging_watch: Watch the Oil & Gas → Gold Miners margin (currently 0.502). A confirmed handoff to Gold would require the margin to cross below zero (i.e., Gold rank score exceeding Oil & Gas) for two consecutive weekly prints AND Gold's breadth to rise above 0.5; until then the leadership read stays with Oil & Gas.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The only leg with genuine risk-control evidence is the absolute-trend gate, which currently favours staying with established-trend eligible names. Oil & Gas is the eligible leader with high score, high durability (0.68), and the strongest breadth (0.786) — breadth is a coincident cohesion read that makes this the least likely theme to suffer an idiosyncratic shake-out over the next month. The rank itself is just a focus lens, so this is a trend-following, vol-aware lean, not a return forecast. Crowding (z=1.04) is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade.
evidence: eligible=true with durability_bar=0.68 (strongest staying-power read among leaders)
theses.dissent: Oil & Gas is the most crowded theme in a market where track-record directional accuracy is only 34%, and crowded leadership in a broad rotation (fraction 0.5) is historically prone to mean-reversion in the leader specifically.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% or more within the 20-day horizon

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the highest-ranking non-crowded challenger (crowding_z=0.2, crowded=false) with eligible=true. It is NOT a call on rotation-timing (no validated edge); it is a humble, trend-following lean on the second-strongest eligible theme with a clean crowding profile. The 0.502 margin to the leader means this is not a CONFIRMED handoff — only a contender worth a low-conviction trend expression with the gate protecting downside.
evidence: rotation margin=0.502 — broad, not a confirmed handoff
theses.dissent: Gold's breadth is only 0.267 — much weaker than the leader's 0.786 — meaning the trend is narrow and could unwind on any single driver, and the poor directional track record (34.3%) argues for no strong conviction

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% or more within the 30-day horizon
